data.body: **[P2] Preserve the coalescing window for synchronous empty checkpoints.** `has_blocked_caller` is set for every completion event, so `QueuedOperation(None, event)` receives only a 1 ms collection window. A scheduling gap can split concurrent empty checkpoints into extra service calls and make the 300-thread e2e assertion scheduler-dependent; mixed batches remain affected after a non-empty synchronous update sets the flag. Track synchronous empty checkpoints separately and make the full poll window take precedence whenever one is present, with staggered standalone and mixed-batch tests.
